description: What the brief asks for versus what is published. Counts are recomputed from the committed rows by scripts/brief_coverage.py; no fixture, price, grade or source is changed here. targets are the brief's, not a claim of achievement. A row can be short of HIGH for several reasons at once, so the blocking counts overlap.

markets_to_investigate: handicap / spread / puck line / run line

source_clocks.notes: The publication clock is the committed snapshot clock, not the wall clock at build time. A pick whose official start has passed since that clock is expired in the browser by assets/release.js. No source was re-verified by this script; no checked_at or quote was renewed. This script fetches nothing: any clock, quote or verification shown elsewhere on the board was read through the page-retrieval tool and is stored with its URL and read time in data/release_checks.json. The shell itself still has no outbound route (FL-077), which is why no OLBG HTML capture can be produced from here.

prose_evidence.note: Counted from each piece's own sources list. "Official host" means a host already recorded in this repository as a governing-body, league or club source; every other host is listed as third-party and is NOT treated as verification. No page was fetched while producing these counts, so a third-party citation is unverified here and is published on the review register instead of being called confirmed.

cross_track.description: Fixtures captured on both tracks are priced by two independent models. Where they disagree on the selection, both versions are published and listed here for review. A disagreement is not evidence that either side is wrong, and neither is a bookmaker price.
